description: Filter active exclusion records by agency, program, classification, geography and dates. Preserve the returned cursor and generation.

classification.description: Official SAM exclusion classification code or label.

country.description: Country name or code in the exclusion record.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from a previous search response.

effective_from.description: Include records effective on or after this ISO date.

effective_to.description: Include records effective on or before this ISO date.

generation.description: Retained snapshot UUID; omit for the current snapshot.

limit.description: Maximum records to return, up to the service page limit.

q.description: Name, identifier, or other text to find in active exclusion records.

state.description: US state name or postal code in the exclusion record.

name: search_exclusions

JsonObject.description: Source-specific JSON map. The envelope is stable; map keys vary by official source.

data.description: Source-specific fields, including provenance and official identifiers.

id.description: Stable identifier for a record in this generation.

summary.description: Short searchable text, when returned by this operation.

url.description: Public canonical path for the record.

coverage.description: Dated source coverage, or an unavailable status.

title: Search exclusions
